notes: qudsn.ps is effectively dead: every path (/robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, /feed, /rss, /post?id=... ) returns the same 332KB static SPA shell (meta x-static-page 2026-10-26, status 200 everywhere), so no date or article data is recoverable from that domain. The shell's own homepage links all articles to the outlet's live domain https://qudsn.co (post?id=NNN&slug=... URLs). qudsn.co/robots.txt (200) allows User-agent: * (only /dashboard, /change-language, /login, /search, /search_page disallowed) and advertises Sitemap: https://qudsn.co/sitemap.xml. That sitemap is ONE flat urlset (4.9MB, 10000 /post entries, full history 2025-01-01..2026-10-25) with <loc>+<lastmod>, no news: namespace. Verified on 8 samples across 09-30/10-10/10-20/10-24: lastmod matches page JSON-LD dateModified exactly and datePublished within ~3 minutes, always same calendar date (site-local +03:00), and pages give 4000-7300 visible chars. Final route: fetch that one sitemap (1 request, ~1s), keep /post URLs whose lastmod date is in 2026-09-25..2026-10-25, dedupe, write URL<TAB>lastmod-date. Output: 690 unique URLs, 31/31 days (09-30=21, 10-10=20, 10-20=20, min day 13). Self-check passed: 4 random sample re-fetches all 200, exact-date match, 4920-7302 chars.
